text:
emily: Quick idea: introduce a 'closure-heartbeat' flow for postmortems to stop drift. short pitch below — want quick takes.

owen: name is catchy. what's the heartbeat cadence?

emily: start with three checkpoints for sev1/2: 72h (heartbeat-1), 14d (heartbeat-2), 45d (heartbeat-3). each checkpoint is a mandatory one-line check-in.

tia: what's included in a one-line check? too many long updates kill adoption.

emily: agreed. one-line checklist fields (single sentence each): status | blocker | next action + ETA | owner. ops-bot will require these in the thread.

marco: cool. how do we prevent ghost owners? we've seen owners drop off after the first week.

emily: two controls: 1) owner must ACK (reaction :white_check_mark:) within 36h of heartbeat ping or ops-bot escalates to secondary; 2) for sev1, reassignment needs secondary ack + manager note in thread.

ops-bot: scheduled job created: "closure-heartbeat/72h" will post to the incident thread and DM owner. Owner has 36h to ack or escalation triggers.

owen: what about recurring-failure detection? we need automatic pattern signals, not manual.

emily: propose rule: if same error-sig appears 3x in 60 days -> label pattern:candidate and auto-open a short pattern-review thread that pings involved owners and infra. pattern-review requires a mitigation plan within 21 days.

tia: can ops-bot attach a short reproduction flag and a risk score so we can sort lists?

emily: yes. metadata fields per remediation: severity, owner, secondary, reproducible(true/false), risk(1-5), next_heartbeat. ops-bot will surface a weekly sorted list by next_heartbeat and risk.

marco: rotation/IC question: if IC rotated mid-incident, who stays on followups?
emily: IC = context keeper for first heartbeat; long-term remediation ownership belongs to the owning service/feature team. the IC should be invited to the 72h check to hand off context, then not required for longer beats.

owen: dashboard idea: a "Heartbeat board" with rows per remediation, columns: lane, owner, age, next_heartbeat, ack_status, pattern_flag. also filters for stuck>48h and risk>3.

emily: UX detail: heartbeat posts include one-click deep link to the remediation ticket and an `ack` button for owners (reaction allowed too).

tia: what about small fixes that will land within 24h? we should allow a fast-close with a short note and ops-bot auto-archives followups.

emily: add rule: if owner marks `fast-close` with ETA <24h, ops-bot will auto verify closure after deploy signal or owner confirmation, otherwise normal heartbeat applies.

ops-bot: feature toggles: ack-by-reaction enabled, fast-close opt-in enabled, pattern-detect set to 3x/60d. weekly digest scheduled to #eng-oncall on Mondays.

marco: action items from this thread: 
1) emily: draft pilot doc + example PM with heartbeat fields and quick-copy template (due Thu EOD).
2) owen: create ops-bot hooks + deep-link button + ack logic (due Mon).
3) tia: small dashboard mock + filter spec (due Wed).
4) marco: define pattern-detect edge cases (logs vs transient) and write detection heuristics (due next Fri).

emily: pilot scope: sev >= P1, 6-week run, then retro.

owen: let's make the heartbeat message super short — owners should be able to reply in place. minimal friction.

tia: agree. I'll mock the UI and show quick-ack flow.

emily: ok i'll post the pilot doc and attach the one-line template. ping me if you want to be on the initial pilot list. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: note: this thread will be pinned to #eng-oncall for pilot visibility.

emily: thanks everyone.
